overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the March 8 and 9, 2022 meetings were held in person at an open location and were also accessible via Zoom, so telephone access was not required.

allegations.summary: Alleged that the Board's March 8 and 9 meetings were inaccessible by telephone, so the public lacked adequate alternative means of access.
allegations.key_passage: As the Board is not required to provide more than one means of adequate, alternative access, we find that the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law where it provided both in-person access and access through the web-based Zoom platform, without also providing access by telephone.

note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
